title: Your menu feedback: approve the hidden name for the new hamburger button, 'Collapse menu' and 'Expand menu'?
bluf: Tap a and your menu change is ready to build the moment the focus-ring fix lands. The new hamburger button has no visible text, but screen readers announce its name, so it needs your words: 'Collapse menu' while the menu is open and 'Expand menu' while it is folded to icons. Two readings of your note, which you can correct here: the menu holding 'Partner workspace' is on the LEFT, so I read your 'right column' as that menu; and on phones and tablets the menu is a slide-out drawer, so the header Menu button stays there and goes only on desktop. The build changes no other word.

options.label: Approve 'Collapse menu' and 'Expand menu'
options.detail: The builder uses exactly these two names for the button (no visible text, no tooltip). On desktop the header Menu button goes; the hamburger sits above 'Partner workspace' and folds the menu to clickable icons; the logo and heading move left (this shows only on windows wider than 1280 px). Then a strict check before anything lands; not deployed.

options.label: Use 'Menu' for both, no new words
options.detail: No new word, but on phones and tablets two buttons would then both be called 'Menu', which is harder for screen-reader users and for the tests to tell apart.

options.label: Hold it
options.detail: Nothing is built yet; I wait for your words or a change to the readings above.

default_action: If you never answer, nothing is built: the change waits for your words.
facts: Your note, verbatim (review site feedback, 2 Nov 22:56 UTC, page /home): '1) please remove the menu button from the top header 2) before Parnter Workspace in the right column, add the hamburger menu lines, when a user clicks this, cal apse the column but leave the icons and make them clickable 3) move the logo and heading left so its left aligned. - kam'.

'Partner workspace' is the first line of the menu (web/src/components/security/SidebarMenu.tsx:14), which renders on the left at desktop width; below 1024 px the menu is an off-screen drawer opened by the header button.
Customer view and the Partner view / Customer view buttons have no icons today; the build adds one from the existing icon sets for each, with no new words.
The menu's open or folded state is remembered in this browser only, as today; nothing is sent to a server.
